reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-08-08 of Shade SILK overcollateralized minting docs and the Shade Lend announcement: SILK is minted by locking 120 to 150%+ accepted collateral in ShadeLend isolated vault markets with stability-pool liquidations; vaults span three documented categories (stablecoins, staking derivatives, normal crypto tokens) with examples including stkd-SCRT, stATOM, stOSMO, stLUNA, IST, DAI, FRAX, and USDC. Secret Network privacy still prevents a public constituent reconciliation and the live whitelist is not published, so the envelope remains 100% DAO-whitelisted vault collateral basket with ku=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Shade documentation of overcollateralized vault backing, Stability Pool liquidations, and collateral redemptions; current private collateral mix undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current collateral identities, balances, and weights cannot be reconciled from the reviewed public sources or private Secret Network state.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: SILK backing sits in ShadeLend vault contracts on Secret Network with no third-party or legal custodian, so there is no bankruptcy-remoteness structure by construction. Secret Network's privacy model prevents reading current vault balances, collateral composition, or admin key configurations from public state; the docs describe collateral as locked until liquidation or repayment but publish no explicit rehypothecation terms.
